messages:
camille: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we need to pick a default approach for session lifecycle: choreography (events between small services) vs single orchestrator service.
camille: TL;DR: choreography reduces central bottleneck but increases async coupling and observability complexity. Orchestrator simplifies migrations but centralizes state and can be a single point of failure.
raj: +1 on the tradeoffs. main worry is operational cost of tracing cascades when multiple services emit session events. Hard to debug timeouts.
amos: Thinking incrementally: keep existing orchestrator but extract a "session-controller" interface so we can split responsibilities gradually.
amos: Proposed adapter interface:
```
interface SessionController {
  StartSession(request) -> session_id
  ExtendSession(session_id, delta) -> ok
  TerminateSession(session_id) -> ok
}
```
amos: We can route legacy traffic to the orchestrator adapter while new features talk to independent services.
sophie: Important: add a compatibility-mode header so both paths emit the same trace parent and session metadata.
sophie: Suggest we add the following automated checks before cutover:
- contract tests for SessionController
- end-to-end smoke that validates session handoff across services
- alert on increased session orphan rate
raj: Also allocate an SLO for session tail-latency before we start splitting. We can't risk user-facing latency regressions.
camille: Agreed. Draft rollout plan:
1) implement SessionController interface and share library
2) proxy adapter in orchestrator that calls into new services if feature flag on
3) smoke tests + perf baseline
4) enable split for non-critical tenants
5) iterate and expand
camille: Timeline: 8 weeks for core work + 2 weeks for ramp & monitoring. We should prioritize paying down tech debt in the orchestrator: remove hard-coded timers and move to a config-driven policy store.
raj: Who owns the first milestone (interface lib + adapter)?
amos: I'll pick up the lib. planning to start next sprint. I'll open a small RFC with module boundaries.
sophie: I'll take observability: spans, metric names, and contract tests.
camille: I'll coordinate rollout and tenant selection. I'll also add a note to the runbook for fallback.
infra-bot: deploy: session-controller-lib v0.1.0 published to internal registry :package:
raj: thanks — next step: amos, sophie, can we sync for 30m tomorrow to align on tracing headers & test harness?
amos: yep, booked.
sophie: thanks, will prepare test checklist and draft alert queries.
camille: perfect. keeping this thread as the coordination log. :thumbsup:
